basic_details.job_title: PGIMER Project Nurse II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research, Chandigarh (PGIMER) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the post of Project Nurse II, with a tenure of one year that is extendable till the completion of the project duration based on performance. The place of posting for this 2026 recruitment is AIIMS Jammu. Candidates applying for the Project Nurse II post must possess a minimum second class or equivalent CGPA in a three-year general nursing and midwifery course. The pay for the post is Rs. 20,000 plus HRA as admissible. Eligible applicants can apply online using the provided link by 5

how_to_apply: Access the online application platform through the official application link.
Fill out the required details in the online form.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Project Nurse II at a Glance

rows.details: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research, Chandigarh

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following qualification and age requirements to apply for the position: Essential Qualification: Minimum second class or equivalent CGPA in a three-year general nursing and midwifery course. Skills: Experience in patient screening, recruitment, follow-ups, and clinical procedures. Age Limit: Maximum 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 20,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible. The appointment is made purely on a temporary basis for an initial duration of one year, which is extendable till the completion of the project duration based on the candidate's performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PGIMER Project Nurse II
content_sections.text: Access the online application platform through the official application link. Fill out the required details in the online form. Submit the completed application form by 5.00 PM on October 17, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves screening of online applications. Selected candidates will be informed about the date of the interview through email.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Project Nurse II post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post is filled purely on a temporary basis for an ICMR-funded multicentric project.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate receives Rs. 20,000 plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Project Nurse II post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit applications online?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is October 17, 2026, by 5.00 PM.
